description:
Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown
Financial Literacy Awareness Programme
Venue: Manav Seva Sangh

RCBU Neena Kalra
In Association with: Suryodaya Foundation

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown organised a Financial Literacy Awareness Programme at Manav Seva Sangh, conducted by Neena Kalra in association with Suryodaya Foundation.

The programme aimed to empower beneficiaries with greater awareness and understanding of financial matters, encouraging informed decisions and better financial management.

The session was well received, and all beneficiaries benefited from the programme. It provided a valuable opportunity to learn, gain practical awareness and understand the importance of financial literacy in everyday life.

Financial literacy is an essential life skill. By creating awareness and sharing knowledge, the initiative took a meaningful step towards building financial confidence, independence and a more secure future among the beneficiaries.

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown sincerely appreciates Neena Kalra and Suryodaya Foundation for conducting this meaningful programme and contributing towards community empowerment.

Empowering Minds • Building Confidence • Creating Lasting Impact
